description: Log a lounge visit (check in). Identify the lounge by its slug OR by lounge_name + airport_iata. Optionally add a 1-5 rating and notes. Idempotent: logging the same lounge on the same date updates the existing visit's rating/notes instead of creating a duplicate.

airport_iata.description: 3-letter airport IATA code — use with lounge_name.

lounge_name.description: Lounge name — use with airport_iata if you don't have the slug.

lounge_slug.description: Lounge slug (from search results). Preferred if known.

name: mark_lounge_visited
title: Log a lounge visit
